summary: Frontend-only re-test of SiAGA Hutan light-theme redesign. Launched paho-mqtt test publisher (device SIAGA-TEST-INGEST) at ~2s cadence (also cycling risk 0/1/2) and verified full UI via Playwright at 1920x1080 and 390x844. Results: dark-green fixed sidebar renders with all 7 nav items (dashboard, peta, peringatan, sensor, kamera, kontrol, riwayat); clicking nav-kontrol smooth-scrolls and sets active. Topbar badges: mqtt-status-badge='MQTT Terhubung', device-status-badge='Node Online' (while fresh telemetry flows, overriding the retained 'offline' LWT), seq-badge increments (SEQ #48130 -> #48134 in 8s), mode-badge='Mode: Live Telemetry'. All 6 sensor cards update live (temp 38.0 C, hum 66.0 %, dust 51.000, gas_v 1.60 V, gas_rs 6000.0 kOhm, rms 0). Leaflet node-map loads OpenTopoMap tiles (10 tiles from *.tile.opentopomap.org/13/..), map-risk-chip reflects live risk (observed WASPADA/BAHAYA). risk-banner-hero + risk-status-text transition AMAN/WASPADA/BAHAYA correctly. camera-snapshot-button, servo-preset-45, servo-pan-slider, fan-speed-preset-max, reset-alarm-button->reset-alarm-confirm all click and publish; toasts render. All 4 chart tabs (climate/hum/gas/rms) switch (aria-selected=true). event-feed-list populated with 13-17 items (command/risk/status/alert kinds). history-tab-telemetry rendered 364 rows; history-tab-alerts rendered 11 rows; history-refresh-button + history-range-select (24 Jam) work. Mobile 390px: sidebar hidden as expected; no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390). 0 console errors. Overall: 100% pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx: footer uses text-slate-400 on #F3F5F1 bg — low contrast (~2.5:1); consider text-slate-500 for a11y.
SensorGrid StatCard max for gas_rs=1000 kOhm but real value observed 6000 -> progress bar clamps at 100% silently; consider raising max or using log scale.
AlertStatus 'camera-viewfinder' uses placeholder only — no actual snapshot delivery path from MQTT image topic yet (acceptable if out-of-scope).
useOnline relies on 15s freshness window; if telemetry cadence >15s device shows Offline. Document expected cadence or make configurable.
test_credentials: N/A (no app auth). MQTT creds from /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Published ~90 telemetry rows + a few alerts as device 'SIAGA-TEST-INGEST' to Supabase during this run (two 180s publisher sessions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Light-theme redesign fully verified. Use `setsid nohup python backend/tests/mqtt_test_pub.py 180 </dev/null >/tmp/mqtt_pub.log 2>&1 &` to feed live telemetry before Playwright UI runs. All data-testids present and stable. Device name 'SIAGA-TEST-INGEST' avoids clobbering real device status (no retained publishes to status topic).
